questions.question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 6 9 2 7 3 5 7 5 9 4 3 1 6 7 5 5 7 4 8 1 1 8 6 9 1 1 6 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
questions.solution:
**Given Series:**

(Left) 6 9 2 7 3 5 7 5 9 4 3 1 6 7 5 5 7 4 8 1 1 8 6 9 1 1 6 (Right)

**Required Pattern:**

Odd → **Odd** → Odd

We need to count those odd numbers which are immediately preceded by an odd number and immediately followed by an odd number.

**Checking the Series:**

(Left) 6 9 2 __**7 3 5 7 5 9**__ 4 3 1 6 __**7 5 5 7**__ 4 8 1 1 8 6 __**9 1 1**__ 6 (Right)

**Odd numbers satisfying the condition:**

→ 3 in (7 3 5)

→ 5 in (3 5 7)

→ 7 in (5 7 5)

→ 5 in (7 5 9)

→ 5 in (7 5 5)

→ 5 in (5 5 7)

→ 1 in (9 1 1)

Valid odd numbers:3, 7, 5, 5, 5, 7, 1

Total = **7**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

 64 + (20 times 4) div 7 - 35 times 5 + 8 div 2 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interchange the signs as given: + → −, − → +, × → ÷, ÷ → ×.

New expression: 64 − (20 ÷ 4) × 7 + 35 ÷ 5 − 8 × 2

Solve using mental BODMAS: 64 − 5 × 7 + 7 − 16

⇒ 64 − 35 + 7 − 16 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Expression:** 64 + (20 × 4) ÷ 7 − 35 × 5 + 8 ÷ 2

**Conditions:**

+ and − are interchanged.

× and ÷ are interchanged.

**Calculation:**

Applying the symbol changes to the expression:

⇒ 64 − (20 ÷ 4) × 7 + 35 ÷ 5 − 8 × 2

Following BODMAS rule (Brackets first):

⇒ 64 − 5 × 7 + 35 ÷ 5 − 8 × 2

Division step:

⇒ 64 − 5 × 7 + 7 − 8 × 2

Multiplication step:

⇒ 64 − 35 + 7 − 16

Addition and Subtraction step:

⇒ 29 + 7 − 16

⇒ 36 − 16

⇒ 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the order of operations: Brackets, Of (orders/powers), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction. Always solve parentheses first.

Mathematical Sign Interchange

In logical reasoning, interchanging signs means replacing every instance of sign A with sign B and vice-versa before starting the calculation.

Priority of Division and Multiplication

Division and Multiplication hold the same rank and are performed from left to right as they appear in the simplified expression.</p

questions.question:
Fawad starts from Point A and drives 13 km towards north. He then takes a right turn, drives 11 km, turns right and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
questions.solution:
**Initial Position:**

Fawad starts from Point A and moves **13 km North**.

**Step-by-step movement:**

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efe0dc4ca359be2c72bed5c39fe9d7140a4fbbc2075aa0ec080e5c651cdea151.png] 

**Calculate final position:**

North-South movement:

13 km North + 1 km North = 14 km North

14 km South

So, vertical movement = 0

East-West movement:

11 km East − 12 km West = 1 km West

So, Point P is **1 km west** of Point A.

To reach Point A again, he must travel **1 km towards the east**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question: A man is standing near a pond and is facing north. First, he turns 90 degrees clockwise, then 45 degrees anticlockwise. Finally, he turns 135 degrees clockwise. In which direction is the man facing now?
questions.solution:
**Initial Direction:**

The man is facing **North**.

**Step 1:** Turn 90° clockwise

North → East

**Step 2:** Turn 45° anticlockwise

East → North-East

**Step 3:** Turn 135° clockwise

North-East → East → South-East → South

Therefore, the man is now facing **South**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
